items.prob: Contrôle chaîne 8 mm après extension garantie

items.risk: Incorrect roue boulons can allow a roue to detach from the véhicule, increasing the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Owners are advised not to drive their vehicles until they have been repaired. Dealers will contrôler and remplacer the roue boulons as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed December 12, 2025. Owners may contact Volkswagen client entretien at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this rappel is 44BW. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on December 5, 2025.

items.risk: A véhicule incendie increases the risk of blessure.
items.fix: Owners are advised to only charge their vehicles to a maximum of 80% batterie capacité until the réparation has been completed. The solution is currently under development. Interim letters, notifying owners of the sécurité risk, are expected to be mailed November 27, 2026. Additional letters will be sent once the solution is available. Owners may contact Volkswagen client entretien at 1-800-893-5298. Volkswagen's number for this rappel is 93EX. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 6, 2026.

items.risk: The siège may not properly restrain the occupant, increasing the risk of blessure during a collision.
items.fix: Tesla entretien Centers will contrôler and tighten or remplacer the siège ensemble fasteners as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed August 16, 2025. Owners may contact Tesla client entretien at 1-877-798-3752. Tesla's number for this rappel is SB-25-13-003.

items.risk: Unintended direction roue movement while the véhicule is stationary increases the risk of an blessure and on the road, a collision.
items.fix: The direction system logiciel will be updated, gratuit, either over-the-air (OTA) or by a concession. propriétaire notification letters were mailed February 6, 2026. Owners may contact BMW client entretien at 1-800-525-7417. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning February 2, 2026.

items.risk: An incorrectly attached direction spindle can lead to a loss of direction control, increasing the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Dealers will contrôler the direction connection and remplacer hardware or remplacer the spindle and column, as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed October 8, 2026.  Owners may contact BMW client entretien at 1-800-525-7417. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel will become searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning October 2, 2026.

items.risk: A loss of drive puissance increases the risk of a collision. An huile fuite in the presence of hot moteur components can increase the risk of an moteur compartment incendie.
items.fix: Dealers will remplacer the moteur, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed October 23, 2025. Owners may contact Hyundai client entretien at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this rappel is 281.

items.risk: An combiné écran that fails to show critical sécurité information, such as the speedometer or warning feux, increases the risk of a collision.
items.fix: The combiné écran logiciel will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a concession, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed March 24, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai's client entretien at 855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this rappel is 293. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on January 28, 2026.

items.risk: Air bags that do not deploy as intended increase the risk of blessure in a collision.
items.fix: Dealers will contrôler and remplacer the impact capteur(s), as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed June 11, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai's client entretien at 855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this rappel is 299. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on April 22, 2026.

items.comp: FORWARD COLLISION AVOIDANCE: AUTOMATIC EMERGENCY BRAKING
items.risk: Unexpected braking increases the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Dealers will mise à jour the front caméra logiciel, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters are expected to be mailed July 17, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai client entretien at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this rappel is 302. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on May 20, 2026.

items.risk: An combiné écran that fails to show critical sécurité information, such as the speedometer or warning feux, increases the risk of a collision.
items.fix: The combiné écran logiciel will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a concession, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters are expected to be mailed August 22, 2026. Owners may contact Hyundai's client entretien at 855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this rappel is 304. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on June 25, 2026.

items.risk: An audible warning chime that does not properly alert of an unbelted ceinture de sécurité can increase the risk of blessure during a collision.
items.fix: Dealers will remplacer the terminals at the audio module connecteur, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed March 26, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Car’s client entretien at 1-800-458-1552. Volvo Car’s number for this rappel is R10365. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on March 13, 2026.

items.risk: A detached head restraint cushion can increase the risk of blessure during a collision.
items.fix: Dealers will apply an adhesive to reinforce the head cushion attachment, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Volvo Car’s client entretien at 1-800-458-1552. Volvo Car’s number for this rappel is R10396. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 9, 2026.

items.risk: An improperly secured ceinture de sécurité retractor may not adequately restrain the siège occupant, increasing the risk of blessure during a collision.
items.fix: Rivian will contrôler and tighten the boulons as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed March 2, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian client entretien at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this rappel is FSAM-1795.

items.risk: Turn signals that do not function properly increase the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Rivian will contrôler and remplacer the front turn signals as necessary, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters were mailed September 28, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian client entretien at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this rappel is FSAM-1833. This is an expansion of rappel 25V387. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel will be searchable on NHTSA.gov on August 31, 2026.

items.risk: An obstructed rearview caméra image can reduce the driver's view behind the véhicule, increasing the risk of a collision.
items.fix: Rivian has released an over-the-air (OTA) mise à jour logicielle, gratuit. propriétaire notification letters are expected to be mailed November 9, 2026. Owners may contact Rivian client entretien at 1-888-748-4261. Rivian's number for this rappel is FSAM-1866. véhicule Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this rappel will be searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 9, 2026.
